scope: M2 Pro 16 GB Llama 3.2 1B affine-4 group-64 packed same-input projections

findings.title: Cover shape-dependent quantized dispatch boundaries
findings.evidence: Pinned Metal dispatch uses M/K/N/device-dependent qmv-to-qmm limits including 10, 12, and 18; packing changes N.
findings.requested_action: Add exact device thresholds plus/minus one or rows 9/10/11, 11/12/13, 17/18/19 to all-layer numerical checks before timing.

findings.title: Check split-output strides and hidden copies
findings.evidence: Quantized matmul requires contiguous final matrix dimensions; slices of packed outputs can have larger row strides.
findings.requested_action: Inspect packed arrays, output split shapes/strides, downstream behavior, and retained bytes; do not claim dispatch savings from source call counts.

findings.title: Avoid constructor allocations and repeated shared projection
findings.evidence: Installed QuantizedLinear constructor creates and quantizes random dense weights; Llama attention separately calls three projections.
findings.requested_action: Use minimal packed module state, execute the shared projection once, retain exact downstream operations, and materialize/release layerwise.

findings.title: Use full dependent requests as selection evidence
findings.evidence: Contributor issue reports opposite conclusions from independently enqueued versus dependency-chained microbenchmarks.
findings.requested_action: Keep microbenchmarks diagnostic; select only with preregistered full-request correctness, latency, tail, and memory gates.

findings.title: Keep current releases and alternatives separate from pinned packing experiment
findings.evidence: Current releases are MLX 0.32.4 and MLX-LM 0.32.2; project pins are 0.32.2 and 0.31.3. Batch, M5, long-context, and cross-runtime evidence differs from the target workload.
findings.requested_action: Preserve pinned environment and preregister alternative experiments with matched controls; do not import external headline gains.

limitations: Static/source and primary-literature review only; no implementation, model weights, numerical outputs, or timing results validated.
Web sources and latest releases may differ from the installed wheel; local pinned artifacts govern execution.
Contributor reports and research headline gains were not independently reproduced and use different hardware/workloads.
Finite feasibility register does not establish exhaustive exploration of every possible method.
Final approval requires independent implementation and raw-data/analysis review after execution.
